result.reason: The redline appropriately extends the licence to affiliates and contractors and permits transfer in an M&A transaction, while preserving the licence’s purpose and platform limitations. However, it allows revocation upon any termination permitted by Section 4, rather than limiting termination of a subscription licence to an uncured material breach, and it does not provide perpetual, irrevocable treatment for any paid-up licence. The margin comment cannot cure this operative shortfall. The changes are otherwise targeted, though the termination formulation is insufficiently precise.
